## Change

Problem and resulting behavior.

## Verification

Commands/results, including checks not run.

## Checklist

- [ ] Correct base: feature → dev, milestone promotion → main.
- [ ] Quality checks pass; relevant failure modes covered.
- [ ] State/handoff updated for substantive work; ADR added if needed.
- [ ] Data/model changes meet research provenance/reproducibility standards.
- [ ] No secrets, private data or generated output.

## Remaining limitations

Open decisions, risks or follow-up.
